summary: Iteration 32 - Landing Page & Admin CRUD Pages Testing. All 11 backend tests passed (100%). All frontend pages tested successfully - Landing page, Admin login, Admin dashboard, Vehicle Types, Stores, Manual Booking, Banners, Payout, and Orders pages all working correctly.

critical_code_review_comments: Landing page implementation is clean with proper data-testid attributes for testing
Admin pages use proper React patterns with useState/useEffect hooks
Vehicle types CRUD endpoints properly validate input and handle errors
AdminBanners and AdminPayout use local state (MOCKED - not backed by API)
All admin pages have proper loading states and empty state handling
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 32 validated the new landing page and admin CRUD pages. Landing page at / shows marketing site for non-authenticated users with hero, services (6 cards), how-it-works, driver recruitment, merchant section, testimonials, CTA, and footer. Admin pages tested: /admin/vehicle-types (CRUD working), /admin/stores (3 merchants), /admin/manual-booking (41 bookings), /admin/banners (3 banners - MOCKED local state), /admin/payout (5 payouts - MOCKED local state), /admin/parcels (7 orders). The /app route shows ClientWelcome onboarding for non-authenticated users.
